packet.sameReference: An earlier operation is unresolved. This material keeps the same consultation reference. Check the result or correct the input and save to the same consultation. Creating another consultation is available after resolving it.
packet.title: Save material for this consultation
packet.notice: Save the contact, appointment, questions and edited sheet to your own account. Nothing is sent to the contact. New records never rewrite saved text automatically.

packet.saved: The operation was confirmed. Nothing was sent to the contact.
packet.new: Keep text and prepare another consultation
packet.newConfirm: Keep this text and treat the next save as a separate consultation? Previous saved material will remain.
packet.openConfirm: Replace the working sheet with the saved version? Copy any unsaved text you need first.
packet.deleteConfirm: Delete the saved material and current working text? Printed and downloaded copies cannot be removed.
packet.keepSaved: Review and use this saved version
packet.keepConfirm: This is saved text. Use this version without adding the latest records?
